parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> Only `ap-southeast-1` is supported.

parameters.name: TagKeyValueParamList
parameters.description: The list of tag key-value parameters.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description:
The description of the tag key.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: TagValueParamList
sub_parameters.description: The list of tag value parameters.
